methodology: Packaged offline build at https://station.test/ (routed, no network). Real session/localStorage, real DOM input in headless Chrome; phone sizes are viewport/touch emulation. ?test=1 fixtures: player placement, save seeding through SaveSession transactions while the yard is closed, storage fault injection, production time shortening. No mock Runtime and no simulated raid result.

steps.name: G2 菜单返回主菜单（backToMenu），再进入仍是院子

G4 开门动画中刷新：标题恢复原行动（不重开、不进院子），撤离后回到院子
steps.detail: 恢复的行动 bc-mv61y6e9-6 与动画前写入的一致

steps.name: G5 城中村样板（?sample=village）：院子与局内轮用一个 Pixi 应用；受跟踪计数对照
